transcript:
Speaker A: Ente college seminar topic-ne kurich entha parayanam enn enikku nannayi ariyamaayirunnu. Pakshe stage-il kayariyathode ente manass poornamayum blank aayi. Avasanam njan paranjathu, "Sir, text book tomorrow I forgot" enna. Enikku English ariyilla ennalla, pakshe oru mistake cheythaal muzhuvan class-um enne nokki chirikkum ennorthu njan valare pedikkunnu. [Speaker A: I knew very well what to say about my college seminar topic. But as soon as I got on stage, my mind went completely blank. In the end, I said, "Sir, text book tomorrow I forgot." It's not that I don't know English, but I am very afraid that if I make a mistake, the whole class will look at me and laugh.]
Speaker B: Vishamikkenda, namukku ath practice cheyyam. Ithu parayoo: "Sir, I forgot to bring my textbook today." [Speaker B: Don't worry, let's practice that. Say this: "Sir, I forgot to bring my textbook today."]
Speaker A: Sir, I... forgot to... bringing my textbook... [Speaker A: Sir, I... forgot to... bringing my textbook...]
Speaker B: Ekdhesham sheriyanu. "Forgot to bring" ennathil kurachu koodi shraddha kodukku. Oru pravashyam koodi cheyyam. [Speaker B: Almost correct. Pay a little more attention to "Forgot to bring". Let's do it one more time.]
Speaker A: Sir, I forgot to bring my textbook today. [Speaker A: Sir, I forgot to bring my textbook today.]
Speaker B: Perfect! 100% accuracy. SpeakX-il ninne judge cheyyaanum allenkil ninne nokki chirikkaanum aarum illa. Neeyum maathramanu ivide. Ninte grammar-um pronunciation-um njan udane correct cheythu tharunnu. Nee Malayalam-il chodyangal chodichaal njan English-il utharam tharukayum cheyyum. [Speaker B: Perfect! 100% accuracy. In SpeakX, there is no one to judge you or laugh at you. It's just you and me here. I will correct your grammar and pronunciation immediately. If you ask questions in Malayalam, I will also answer in English.]
Speaker A: Thank you AI teacher. Pakshe ithu valare chelavulla oru app aayirikkum alle? [Speaker A: Thank you AI teacher. But this must be a very expensive app, right?]
Speaker B: Ithu India-yile ettavum kuranja chilavil English padhippikkunna app aanu. Oru aazhchayude trial verum 2 rupa maathram. [Speaker B: This is the app that teaches English at the lowest cost in India. A one-week trial is just 2 rupees.]
Speaker A: Adipoli! Angane aanenkil njan ippol thanne download cheyyam. [Speaker A: Awesome! If so, I will download it right now.]

An interactive AI teacher from SpeakX helps him practice and correct his pronunciation in a private, judgment-free environment.
